name: whd_search
description: Search concluded US Department of Labor Wage & Hour Division enforcement cases since FY2005 — wage theft, back wages, minimum wage and overtime violations, child labour, H-1B and H-2A findings. Filter by employer name, NAICS industry code, or state. Returns the employer, industry, violation count, employees due back wages, civil money penalties and the findings dates for each case. Use for "has <employer> been cited for wage violations".

employer.description: Employer name, matched as a substring against both the trade name and the legal name.

naics.description: NAICS industry code as stored by WHD (e.g. "09310").

since.description: Only cases whose findings END on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

name: whd_employer
description: Full Wage & Hour enforcement history for one employer, with per-case detail and aggregate violation and back-wage figures across every concluded case. Matches the employer against both the registered trade name and the legal name and reports which one hit. Use to answer whether a company is a repeat wage-violation offender.

employer.description: Employer name, matched against trade name and legal name.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

name: whd_top_backwages
description: Rank employers by back wages owed in concluded Wage & Hour enforcement cases, optionally within one NAICS industry or state. Returns cases ordered by the recorded back-wage amount, highest first, with employer, industry and findings dates. Use for "who owes the most back wages in <industry>".

since.description: Only cases whose findings END on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

naics.description: Restrict to one NAICS industry code.

state.description: Restrict to one two-letter state code.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

name: whd_coverage
description: Report what the Wage & Hour enforcement dataset currently covers: its publication date, update frequency and the findings-date range of the cases returned by a sample query. Use to check how current the enforcement data is before relying on an absence of cases.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.
